functions.name: compactForJson
functions.doc: Builds a value whose objects are positional arrays, so property names never reach the wire.

functions.name: compactFromJson
functions.doc: Rebuilds a keyed object from the positional array the compact encoder wrote.

functions.name: formatTransform
functions.doc: Applies the type's format rules to a value, for example trimming a string or clamping a number.

functions.name: jsonDecoder
functions.doc: Turns a JSON string back into a typed value. The strategy decides whether undeclared properties survive.

functions.name: jsonEncoder
functions.doc: Turns a value into a JSON string. The strategy picks how: build a new value, transform in place, or use the compact positional wire.

functions.name: jsonSchema
functions.doc: Returns the JSON Schema document describing the type.

functions.name: prepareForJsonClone
functions.doc: Builds a new JSON-safe value from the declared shape, so undeclared properties are dropped.

functions.name: prepareForJsonMutate
functions.doc: Turns a value into a JSON-safe value in place. Nothing is allocated and undeclared properties are kept.

functions.name: removeUnknownKeys
functions.doc: Copies a value keeping only the properties the type declares.

functions.name: restoreFromJsonClone
functions.doc: Rebuilds the typed shape from a JSON-safe value, so undeclared properties are dropped.

functions.name: restoreFromJsonMutate
functions.doc: Turns a JSON-safe value back into the typed shape in place, keeping undeclared properties.

functions.name: validate
functions.doc: Answers whether a value matches the type. The cheapest check, and the one every other validator builds on.

functions.name: validateStrict
functions.doc: Answers whether a value matches the type AND carries no undeclared properties, in a single walk.

functions.name: validateUnionKeys
functions.doc: Answers whether a value matches the type AND carries no property the matched union member leaves undeclared.

functions.name: validationErrors
functions.doc: Returns the list of reasons a value does not match the type, with the path to each one.

functions.name: validationErrorsStrict
functions.doc: Returns the reasons a value does not match, including undeclared properties, in a single walk.

functions.name: validationErrorsUnionKeys
functions.doc: Returns the reasons a value does not match, counting a property the matched union member leaves undeclared.
